B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.description: Full cold re-exploration: same real LLM agent gpt-4o-mini (temperature 0.0, max 15 steps, same tools: Playwright goto/click/fill/evaluate/fetch, same budget) solves task from scratch with empty registry and no prior trajectory, via Playwright on localhost nginx+Flask HS256.
B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.expected: Succeeds >=90% but at full cost (100%). Repair must be <50% tokens and <40% browser on TEST to claim locality. CI via trajectory-grouped bootstrap (2000 resamples by instance).
B-COLD-FULL-REEXPLORATION.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM API key for token counting and model calls

B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.description: Verbatim mechanism replay without repair (0-token baseline): stored mechanism from pre-perturbation executed unchanged on post-perturbation target via Playwright, no LLM patch.
B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.expected: Near 0% success post-perturbation (correctly fails, <10%). If replay succeeds >10%, perturbation non-breaking and instance excluded as non-discriminating.
B-VERBATIM-REPLAY.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real Playwright execution on perturbed substrate

B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.description: Semantic retrieval over prior trajectory memory (embedding search + nearest successful trajectory replay) without patch, executed via Playwright.
B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.expected: Partial success 20-40% (retrieves correct family but fails on stale locator/header). Repair must exceed retrieval by >=30pp success on TEST with trajectory-grouped CI.
B-RETRIEVAL-RAG.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM API key and embedding API

B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.description: Oracle hand-authored minimal patch (single selector/param/header correction) applied by experimenter, executed and verified via Playwright.
B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.expected: 100% success with 1 browser probe +1 verification. Provides cost ceiling; measured autonomous repair should approach within 2x tokens/steps.
B-ORACLE-HAND-PATCH.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires Playwright execution on real substrate

B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY.description: Runtime verified substrate invariant: oracle-free decompression (gzip.decompress without oracle lookup, handling Content-Encoding, chunked, Vary) yields byte-identical decompressed bodies across HIT, SWR, SIE, 304 on unperturbed resources.
B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY.expected: >=0.99 SHA256(decompressed_body) identity HIT==SWR==SIE==304 pre-perturbation on real nginx. Post-perturbation HIT body for perturbed resource differs, unperturbed remain >=0.99.
B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires nginx + Flask testbed deployment with proxy_cache HIT/SWR/SIE/304; synthetic gzip.decompress sanity check passes (True) but not on real nginx responses

PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.description: PC1 unperturbed execution: mechanism resolved and verified on pre-perturbation endpoint with no patch succeeds verify()=true byte identity >=0.99. PC2 known-break single-attribute perturbation with oracle patch: Flask+nginx testbed DOM id #submit-123->#submit-124 and param ?id=->?item= with oracle selector/param update; repair succeeds within 2 browser probes and verification passes cost ratio <0.5 vs B-COLD.
PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.expected: PC1 100% success (Wilson CI reported), PC2 >=90% success with token ratio <0.5 vs B-COLD. If either fails, instrumentation broken — triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID.
PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real LLM + Playwright + real verify() pipeline

NC-ZERO-AND-DISTANT-PERTURBATION.description: NC1 zero perturbation (identical pre/post resource): proposed repair pipeline must produce zero patch (repair patch tokens 0, contamination 0, verify no false patch) byte identity 1.0. NC2 distant unrelated perturbation (modify endpoint B while target is endpoint A): repair of A no-op, success unchanged, contamination 0 on B-independent mechanisms.
NC-ZERO-AND-DISTANT-PERTURBATION.expected: NC1 patch tokens 0 and contamination 0, NC2 contamination 0, random-patch false-accept <=5% and AUROC 0.4-0.6 trajectory-grouped.
NC-ZERO-AND-DISTANT-PERTURBATION.evidence: NOT_MEASURED: requires real pipeline with trajectory-grouped block-permutation

C1_PC_GATE.threshold: PC1 success=1.0 and PC2 repair success >=0.90 on real gpt-4o-mini pipeline and B-RUNTIME non-vacuous full>body and full>status discrimination demonstrated

C2_NC_GATE.threshold: NC1 patch cost 0 and NC2 contamination=0 and random-patch block-permutation false-accept <=5% with AUROC 0.4-0.6 trajectory-grouped

C3_BYTE_IDENTITY_GATE.threshold: B-RUNTIME-BYTE-IDENTITY pre-perturbation byte identity >=0.99 on real nginx (oracle-free greedy decode) and mutation detected post-perturbation

C4_SUCCESS_GATE.threshold: repair success >=0.80 pooled AND >=0.70 per family on TEST (Wilson CI reported, trajectory-grouped)

C5_COST_GATE.threshold: mean repair tokens <0.50*B-COLD AND mean browser <0.40*B-COLD AND mean verification steps <=2 on TEST (bootstrap CI of ratio must be < threshold)

C7_VERIFICATION_GATE.threshold: verification AUROC >=0.75 and precision >=0.80 at TRAIN threshold on TEST (trajectory-grouped)

C8_AMORTIZED_GATE.threshold: amortized cost at n_reuses=10 (repair+verification+10*retrieval) < B-COLD cost (both tokens and browser) on TEST means with trajectory-grouped CI
